title: docs(sso): the OIDC flow names a /sign-in/oauth2 endpoint that does not exist
body:
Found by the dev on PR #21872 (card #21846) while updating `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`. This is older drift and has nothing to do with that PR's linking change.

- **What is wrong:** step 2 of the OIDC flow in the page's "OAuth flow" section tells the reader to call `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/oauth2` with a `providerId`.
- **Why it is wrong:**
  - Under the installed better-auth (1.7.3), the generic-oauth plugin adds no endpoints of its own. It uses the core `/sign-in/social` and `callback/:id`.
  - `auth-route-ledger.ts` has no `sign-in/oauth2` row.
  - The tests in #21872 sign in to generic providers through `/sign-in/social`.
- **Fix:** rewrite the OIDC flow steps against the routes the auth route ledger actually registers, and re-check the rest of the page's flow section the same way.
- **Owning repo:** `objectstack`, docs only.
